# messq_serve

See `messq help exit-codes` for the exit-code contract.

## messq serve

run the messq daemon

### Synopsis

Run the messq daemon against a data directory, serving the HTTP API over a
Unix socket or loopback TCP.

serve keeps its own section-8 flag set and its own environment
fallbacks; it exits 74 when storage latched read-only, 75 when the
data directory is locked by another daemon, and 78 when the
configuration can never work — systemd's RestartPreventExitStatus
depends on those values.

```
messq serve [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  messq serve --data-dir /var/lib/messq # noexec: starts a long-running daemon
  messq serve --listen tcp://127.0.0.1:4390 # noexec: starts a long-running daemon
```
